content:
DIGITALbuilt recognised as a European Digital Innovation Hub!

DIGITALbuilt is a collaborative initiative of AEC Cluster (PTPC – Portuguese Technological Platform for Construction), Portuguese Railway Platform Cluster (PFP), ACPMR – Association Cluster Portugal Mineral Resources, BUILT CoLAB, Itecons Interface Centre, StoneCITI, FI Group and FNWAY, and was now recognized as European Digital Innovation Hub for the Initial Network of European Digital Innovation Hubs (DIGITAL-2021-EDIH-INITIAL-01) of the Digital Europe Programme.

This recognition is of enormous importance for DIGITALbuilt, already recognized in the National network, and will contribute even more to maximize its impact and area of action, now extended to Europe. Good news for SMEs and Public Administration that will have this European Innovation Hub to become even more innovative, sustainable and efficient.

Another great little step that the AEC Sector takes in the Twin Transition of the Built Environment!
